description: A SprintZero-branded GitHub Gist viewer that serves as the client-facing deliverable platform. Clean URLs like diff.sprintzero.sh/encappture map to GitHub Gists via a JSON registry. Built from scratch, inspired by gists.sh. Next.js 16, Bun, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, Shiki, oxlint, oxfmt. Dark-first design with SprintZero orange accent. Deployed to diff.sprintzero.sh on Vercel.
human_inputs_required: GITHUB_TOKEN: GitHub Personal Access Token with `gist` scope. Generate at https://github.com/settings/tokens → Fine-grained or Classic → select 'gist' scope only. This raises API rate limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour. Set in Vercel environment variables and .env.local for development.
VERCEL_PROJECT: Create a new Vercel project linked to the diff.sprintzero.sh repo. Add diff.sprintzero.sh as a custom domain in Vercel project settings → Domains.
DNS_RECORD: Add CNAME record on sprintzero.sh domain: diff → cname.vercel-dns.com (or whatever Vercel specifies during domain setup).

features.description: Create the deliverables registry — JSON config mapping clean slugs to gist IDs
steps: Create file: src/lib/registry.ts
Define TypeScript interface DeliverableProject: { gistId: string, name: string, date?: string }
Define interface DeliverableCustomer: { name: string, default?: string, projects: Record<string, DeliverableProject> }
Define interface DeliverableRegistry: Record<string, DeliverableCustomer>
Create file: deliverables.json at project root with initial structure:
{ "encappture": { "name": "Encappture", "default": "cms-modernization", "projects": { "cms-modernization": { "gistId": "PLACEHOLDER", "name": "CMS React Modernization", "date": "2026-03" } } } }
In registry.ts, import deliverables.json and export as typed DeliverableRegistry
Implement resolveSlug(slugParts: string[]): { gistId: string, customer?: DeliverableCustomer, project?: DeliverableProject } | null

Resolution logic: (1) single segment matching customer slug with default project → resolve default gist ID. (2) single segment that is hex 20/32 chars → raw gist ID (direct/dev access). (3) two segments [customer, project] → look up both → gist ID. (4) no match → null.
Export helper: getCustomerByGistId(gistId: string) — reverse lookup for footer metadata

Verify: resolveSlug(['encappture']) returns gist ID. resolveSlug(['encappture', 'cms-modernization']) returns same. resolveSlug(['abc123def456789012345678']) returns raw ID. resolveSlug(['nonexistent']) returns null.

features.description: Implement GitHub Gist API data layer with types and fetch functions
steps: Create file: src/lib/github.ts
Define TypeScript interface GistFile: filename, type, language (string|null), raw_url, size, content
Define interface GistOwner: login, avatar_url, html_url
Define interface Gist: id, description (string|null), public (boolean), files (Record<string, GistFile>), owner (GistOwner|null), created_at, updated_at, html_url
Define interface GitHubUser: login, avatar_url, html_url, name (string|null), bio (string|null), blog (string|null), twitter_username (string|null), location (string|null)
Implement getGitHubHeaders() returning Authorization bearer from process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN

Implement fetchGist(gistId: string): Promise<Gist|null> — GET api.github.com/gists/{gistId} with next: { revalidate: 86400, tags: [`gist-${gistId}`] }. Validate hex 20/32. Null on 404. Throw on rate limit.
Implement fetchUser(username: string): Promise<GitHubUser|null> — GET api.github.com/users/{username} with next: { revalidate: 86400 }
Implement file type detection: isMarkdown, isJSON, isYAML, isCSV, isICS, isPlainText, isStructuredData, getFileExtension, getMimeType
Verify: fetchGist with a known public gist ID returns data

features.description: Implement API routes: raw content and cache refresh
steps: Create file: src/app/api/raw/[gistId]/route.ts
GET handler: fetch gist, extract file by ?file param or first file, return with correct Content-Type
Create file: src/app/api/refresh/[gistId]/route.ts
POST handler: revalidateTag(`gist-${gistId}`), return 200
Rate limit: in-memory Map, reject 429 if within 60 seconds
Verify: POST /api/refresh/{gistId} returns 200, repeat within 60s returns 429
